episodes.title: A3 — tightened, no breath
episodes.synopsis: Inhale removed, room tone softened, gaps trimmed ~33%. Sentences that belong together now run closer: 0.15-0.18 s added where a thought continues, 1.05 s at the turn. Still well above the model's own 183-344 ms.
